lines.style: Speak English as a polite Japanese beginner ordering at a fast-food counter. Say every word exactly as written: 'cock' rhymes with 'rock' and 'clock', a short open 'ah' vowel (/kɑk/), crisp k at the end, so a listener clearly hears 'One cock, please.' Slightly flat, syllable-by-syllable Japanese-style timing. Natural, not a caricature.
